nonclaims: Release-surface acceptance proves local artifact consistency, not comprehension or usability across all recipients.
Complete public history covers durable Lacuna play-purpose turns before one checkpoint, not uncommitted external chat or lost transcript bodies.
A clean exact-token scan does not prove provider memory erasure, semantic independence, filesystem confinement, or absence of unretained channels.
Passing schemas, audits, histories, receipts, scans, bundles, and package checks does not prove narrative quality or retcon-planning efficacy.
Provider/model/context/timing/cost/tool metadata remain host declarations unless independently attested.
A local manifest and verifier are not a digital signature, trusted timestamp, or remote transparency log.
acceptance_note: Rev0166 is the send-oriented release: it combines the strongest complete-history and whole-retained-tree contamination branches, adds a clean post-checkpoint context label and streaming scan refactor, and makes the player, researcher, and operator entrances actual audited package members.
